correctness.rationale: Every maximal independent set in the clique with a two-edge tail has size exactly two. A diameter-three and distance-pair argument proves chi_rho=m, an explicit order and maximal color-1 class prove Gamma_rho=m+1 for all m>=3. The unique minimum-order obstruction follows from exhaustive unlabeled adjacency-mask generation and explicit enumeration of all bounded packing/first-fit color maps for orders 1..5; the standalone verifier was executed, and its recorded census is independently reconstructible from code.

originality.rationale: The 2024 founding study poses well-covered equality as Problem 6.3 and proves it only under diameter two; the explicit diameter-three connected infinite family and sharp size-five uniqueness are not assertions of the inspected paper. Several semantic research-record queries returned no direct equivalent, with residual risk from later uncatalogued papers.
residual_risks: A post-2024 answer might be unindexed, unpublished or inaccessible.
The full text of the later packing-criticality article was not inspected; abstract-level inapplicability alone is not proof of exclusion.
The general diameter-three optimization theorem covers the quantitative parameter once any specific graph is supplied, though it does not solve the published existence problem.
